# EDUCA VEDA — Ayurvedic Healing, Rogsetu & Gurukul
> Results Not Promises. Pure Himalayan Ayurvedic Healing, Nadi Parikshan, and Certified Clinical Wellness.

## Overview
EDUCA VEDA is an authentic Indian Ayurvedic wellness and healthcare enterprise headquartered in India. It specializes in 100% natural, AYUSH-certified herbal formulations with zero side-effects, non-invasive pulse diagnosis (Rogsetu Nadi Parikshan), and professional clinical training through Educa Gurukul.

## Core Realms & Offerings
1. **EDUCA HEALTH (Store)**:
   - Himalayan Shuddh Jadi Booti & Rasayanas
   - Cellular healing, natural immunity, and zero-dependency herbal medicines
   - Range includes: Pure Rasayanas, herbal oils, digestion supplements, vitality blends, and skin/hair care formulations.
   - URL: https://educa-store.vercel.app/?page=store

2. **EDUCA ROGSETU & WELLNESS CONSULTATION**:
   - Classical Nadi Parikshan (Ayurvedic Pulse Diagnosis)
   - Zero surgery, zero toxic radiation/laser diagnostics
   - Tridosha (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) balance analysis by certified Vaidyas
   - URL: https://educa-store.vercel.app/?page=services

3. **EDUCA GURUKUL**:
   - Clinical Diploma training in Ayurvedic herbology (Dravyaguna), Panchakarma, and disease management
   - Prepares students to become certified Wellness Consultants
   - Affordable course fees with community healthcare empowerment
   - URL: https://educa-store.vercel.app/?page=services

4. **DISTRIBUTOR & DIRECT SELLER NETWORK**:
   - Multi-tier decentralized distribution network
   - Direct Seller commission, PPC liquidity rewards, and lifetime royalty pools
   - URL: https://educa-store.vercel.app/?page=join
